_provenance.recovered: The `previous` values were recovered on 2026-08-05 from the originating session's transcript. They were nearly lost: the deliberate backup (cp pins/q7.json /tmp/.../q7pins.bak) was destroyed with /tmp, and this directory was UNTRACKED in git, so nothing on disk held the baseline. That is why the directory is tracked now — an untracked pin file makes `--update-pins` unauditable, and an auditor with only the checkout cannot tell a verified improvement from a silent re-bless.
